products.title: 8*10/100/1000Base-T + 2*1G/2.5G SFP Layer 2+ Managed Ethernet Switch
products.meta_description: 8*10/100/1000Base-T + 2*1G/2.5G SFP Layer 2+ Managed Ethernet Switch, LT-S8310G-2GX8GT, SmartByte
products.overview:
SmartByte
LT-S8310G-2GX8GT is a Layer 2+ full gigabit managed switch, which features 8-port 10/100/1000Base-T RJ45 and 2*1G/2.5G SFP ports. It supports Layer 3 static routing with a high-performance switching architecture and offers wire-speed transportation capability for delivering a cost-effective Gigabit Ethernet solution to meet the converged applications for enterprise customer's networks. More and more corporations are adapting new IT technologies over the network such as voice over IP, video conference to improve productivity and save operation expenditure. The LT-S8310G-2GX8GT provides comprehensive end to end QoS as well as flexible and rich management, security settings, which can meet the high speed, secure and smart requirement for small and medium-size enterprise networks based on cost effective price.
features: 2*1G/2.5G SFP slots uplink, 8 *10/100/1000BASE-T ports downlink, 1*RJ45 console interface for switch basic management and setup.
Marvell AC5 series 1.2GHz CPU, Marvell AC5 series switch chipsets, 512MB RAM and 512MB flash
IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCPv4/ DHCPv6 client, DHCPv4 relay, DHCP relay.
Supports port aggregation, IEEE802.3x flow control, port isolation, port mirroring, loop detection and broadcast storm suppression
Supports IEEE802.1Q tagged VLAN, mac based VLAN, IP based VLAN, protocol based VLAN, voice VLAN and private VLAN.
Supports port-based, VLAN-based and flow-based QinQ
Supports STP, RSTP, MSTP, G.8032 ERPS protocol, single ring, sub ring
IGMP snooping, IGMP v1, v2, v3, PIM-SM
QoS class, remarking, Supports SP, WRR queue scheduling, Ingress/Egress port-based rate-limit
port-security, IP source guard, ARP-check, DAI, anti-gateway ARP spoofing,
Ddos attack protection, telnet/SSH/HTTP/HTTPS user access control and AAA.
Loop detect based on port or VLAN, the Ethernet in the first mile 802.3ah
Supports IPv4/IPv6 dual stack management, system log management, user management,
login service management, firmware management, web management, CLI management, fault detection, DNS,
NTP, sFlow, SNMP, MQTT, RMON and dual partition management.
Supports telnet server, telnet client, SCP, SFTP, SSH server, TACACS and TFTP client

products.overview:
SmartByte
LT-S8328G-20GX8GC
is the Layer 2+ full gigabit managed switch, which provide high-density performance, Layer 3 static routing with 68Gbps switching capacity. The LT-S8328G-20GX8GC provides comprehensive end to end QoS as well as flexible and rich management, security settings, which can meet the high speed, secure and smart requirement for small and medium-size enterprise networks based on cost effective price. The powerful network security features also make the LT-S8328G-20GX8GC perform effective data traffic control for ISP and enterprise VoIP, video streaming, and multicast applications.
features: 4*1G/2.5G SFP slots uplink, 16*100/1000M SFP ports and 8*1G SFP/RJ45 COMBO ports downlink, 1*RJ45 console interface for switch basic management and setup.
Marvell AC5 series 1.2GHz CPU, Marvell AC5 series switch chipsets, 512MB RAM and 512MB flash
IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCPv4/ DHCPv6 client, DHCPv4 relay, DHCP relay.
Supports port aggregation, IEEE802.3x flow control, port isolation, port mirroring, loop detection and
Supports IEEE802.1Q tagged VLAN, mac based VLAN, IP based VLAN, protocol based VLAN, voice VLAN and
Supports port-based, VLAN-based and flow-based QinQ
Supports STP, RSTP, MSTP, G.8032 ERPS protocol, single ring, sub ring
IGMP snooping, IGMP v1, v2, v3, PIM-SM
QoS class, remarking, Supports SP, WRR queue scheduling, Ingress/Egress port-based rate-limit
port-security, IP source guard, ARP-check, DAI, anti-gateway ARP spoofing,
Ddos attack protection, telnet/SSH/HTTP/HTTPS user access control and AAA.
Loop detect based on port or VLAN, the Ethernet in the first mile 802.3ah
Supports IPv4/IPv6 dual stack management, system log management, user management,
login service management, firmware management, web management, CLI management, fault detection, DNS,
NTP, sFlow, SNMP, MQTT, RMON and dual partition management.
Supports telnet server, telnet client, SCP, SFTP, SSH server, TACACS and TFTP client

68
Gbps switching capacity. The LT-
S
8328GP series provide comprehensive end to end QoS as well as flexible and rich management, security settings, which can meet the high speed, secure and smart requirement for small and medium-size enterprise networks based on cost effective price. With total power consumption up to
440
W
(850W optional)
,
i
t offers a rack-mountable, affordable, safe and reliable power solution for SMBs deploying Power over Ethernet networks, or requiring enhanced data security and network traffic management.

The powerful network security features also make the LT-S8328XGP-4XS24GT perform effective data traffic control for ISP and enterprise VoIP, video streaming, and multicast applications. optional)

products.overview:
SmartByte LT-S8352GP-4
GX
48GT-4BT series are the Layer 2+ managed Gigabit PoE++ switch. They deliver full Gigabit access and provide high-density performance, Layer 3 static routing with
144
Gbps switching capacity. The LT-S8352GP-4
GX
48GT-4BT series provide comprehensive end to end QoS as well as flexible and rich management, security settings, which can meet the high speed, secure and smart requirement for small and medium-size enterprise networks based on cost effective price. The powerful network security features also make the LT-S8352GP-4
GX
48GT-4BT series perform effective data traffic control for ISP and enterprise VoIP, video streaming, and multicast applications. Complying with IEEE 802.3af/at/bt full PoE standards, they deliver a maximum 740W PoE budget. Ports 1–4 support 90W PoE++ for high-power IoT terminals, while the remaining ports support standard PoE/PoE+. Built-in PoE scheduling, watchdog and over-current protection guarantee intelligent and safe power supply, which can be widely deployed in HD surveillance, high-density Wi-Fi 6 networking, smart building automation, and enterprise unified communication systems

products.overview:
The SmartByte
LT-IS6312GP-4GX8GT-D-BST
is the highly reliable managed industrial boost PoE switch with 8-port 10/100/1000-T PoE and 4-port 1000/2500Base-X fiber optical interfaces. It adopts DC 12-57V power boost technology to solve power source only 12-24V but require to support PoE, and no special power supplies needed.
It transforms a limited 12-24V power source into a robust, standards-compliant PoE network
, which can support IEEE802.3af, IEEE802.3at standard PoE protocol, the Max power consumption can reach 30W (PoE+) per port. It also supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism is less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution.
LT-IS6312GP-4GX8GT-D-BST
supports DI/DO/RS485 and robust layer 2 management function.
LT-IS6312GP-4GX8GT-D-BST
is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 12-57VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for
mobile transportation & vehicle mounted systems, solar-powered & off-deployments and industrial environments with DC backplanes application scenarios

products.overview:
The SmartByte
LT-IS6328XG-4XS16GX8GC-U-SD
is the highly reliable managed industrial Ethernet switch with 16-port 100/1000Base-X SFP, 8-port gigabit RJ45/SFP Combo and 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+. It also supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism is less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution.
LT-IS6328XG-4XS16GX8GC-U-SD
supports DI/DO/RS485,
it can work with temperature-humidity sensor to collect environmental data and trigger alarms, which is critical for the industrial application requiring the stable ambient conditions
LT-IS6328XG-4XS16GX8GC-U-SD
is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including redundant AC+DC, DC+DC and AC+AC power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 80°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy
industrial factory,
transportation, oil & gas, chemical,
IP Surveillance
and processing automation area
where environmental conditions are harsh and critical
.

products.overview:
The SmartByte LT-IS6312G-4GX8GT-FBP is is a specialized industrial managed bypass switch featured with 8-port 10/100/1000-T RJ45, 4-port 1G/2.5GBase-X SFP and 1 channel single fiber bypass port. In normal operation, it is a L2+ managed Ethernet switch. It supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution.
IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server
, robust Layer 2 management and secure functions can help users expand their networks quickly and efficiently. However, when it encounters a power failure or internal malfunction, the bypass function is activated through the integrated bypass optical switching module, which allows the network connections passing through the switch to remain uninterrupted, ensuring that the data can still flow directly between the connected devices, as if the switch were not in the path at all.
LT-IS6312G-4GX8GT-FBP is also the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 24-58VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse/over-current protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy
industrial factory,
transportation, oil & gas, chemical,
IP Surveillance
and processing automation area
where environmental conditions are harsh and critical

breadcrumb: 8*10/100/1000Base-T + 4*1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+ L2+ Managed Industrial PoE++ Switch with Temp-humidity Sensor
products.overview:
The SmartByte
LT-IS6312XGP-4XS8GT-SD-8BT
is the highly reliable managed industrial PoE++ switch with 8-port 10/100/1000-T PoE and 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X fiber optical interfaces. It supports IEEE802.3af, IEEE802.3at standard and IEEE802.3bt PoE protocol, the Max power consumption can reach 90W (PoE++) per port. It also supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism is less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution.
LT-IS6312XGP-4XS8GT-SD-8BT
supports DI/DO/RS485,
it can work with temperature-humidity sensor to collect environmental data and trigger alarms, which is critical for the industrial application requiring the stable ambient conditions
LT-IS6312XGP-4XS8GT-SD-8BT
is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 52-57VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy industrial factory, transportation, oil & gas, chemical, IP Surveillance and processing automation area where environmental conditions are harsh and critical.
